title: Para Bakti Nyang Meujanji .
intro: Sidroe nabi nyang jihoreumat geujak lamkawan umat, geutawök awaknyan ubak keubeunaran. Le that nyang meuputa-puta deungon teugaih até, teuma saboh lingkaran ubit nyang seutia jijaweueb panggilan nyan dan jimeujanji deungon sipeunoh até. Awaknyan ji-uji ngon ragu-ragu dan beurani jimita rezeki lam syeuruga. Bakti awaknyan nyang hana meu-ubah-ubah jeuet keu saboh peulajaran iman nyang hana meu-ubah-ubah. Soe-soe awaknyan?
clues: Kamoe na kheueh saboh keulompok ubit nyang beudôh keu jidukông saboh misi ilahi bak masa nyang hana meuiman nyang luah.
Sidroe nabi nyang that geuhoreumat teuka dan geukheun keu geutanyoe beu tadong seubagoe sekutu lam jalan Allah.
Watèë nabi geutanjong soë njang akan djeuët keu pendukung Ilahi, kamoë djaweuëb deungon hana ragu-ragu.
Kamoe beurani meulakèe saboh khanduri ajaéb nyang geukirém nibak langét keu geupeukong até kamoe.
Nabi geutanjoë geupeuingat geutanjoë supaja tapeu-ingat Allah meunjo geutanjoë ureuëng meu-iman njang beutôi, bah that pih lakèë geutanjoë njang meu-ulang-ulang njan ka geu-hormati.
Kamoe nakeuh lingkaran dalam nyang seutia nyang meujanji iman nyang hana meugoyang di samping Isa, aneuk Maryam.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
